scope.claim: verified end-to-end proving performance without hidden geometry, work, memory, proof-size, verifier, or backend regressions
non_goals: using an isolated pre-proof microbenchmark as production-promotion evidence
replacing correctness, soundness, formal, or independent-verifier gates
pooling CPU and Metal results into one verdict
selecting a benchmark or target after candidate measurements are visible

strictness.object_policy: closed; duplicate, missing, and unknown fields are rejected by the protocol and receipt validators
strictness.number_policy: finite JSON integers or finite JSON numbers only; NaN, infinity, numeric strings, and negative durations or byte counts are rejected
strictness.null_policy: null is permitted only for a field the protocol declares inapplicable to that lane or milestone; an unavailable applicable field produces NO_VERDICT
strictness.path_policy: repository paths are normalized repository-relative paths with no parent traversal
strictness.identity_policy: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 for files and artifacts; lowercase hexadecimal Git object IDs for commits and trees
strictness.mutation_policy: this protocol is frozen before a candidate capture; changing corpus, statistics, or thresholds requires a new version and reviewed rationale before new candidate results are inspected
strictness.failure_policy: attempts are append-only and cannot be retried, replaced, reordered, or omitted

statistical_authority.relationship: reuse the authenticated estimator and sampling semantics; this typed-AIR protocol remains the promotion authority for its own corpus and budgets
statistical_authority.estimator: Hodges-Lehmann Walsh-average location over round ratios
statistical_authority.bootstrap_seed: first 32 bits, big-endian, of SHA-256 over subject_id + ':0'

comparison_contract.arm_a: baseline source or the explicitly named same-candidate reference configuration
comparison_contract.arm_b: candidate source or the explicitly named same-candidate subject configuration
comparison_contract.baseline: the reviewed predecessor commit and tree frozen in the capture plan before candidate execution
comparison_contract.candidate: the clean candidate commit and tree proposed to close the milestone
same_between_arms: worker count except in an explicitly declared M7 or M9 scaling comparison
comparison_contract.speed_ratio: median baseline duration divided by median candidate duration; larger is better
comparison_contract.resource_ratio: median candidate resource divided by median baseline resource; smaller is better
comparison_contract.round_ratio: compute the appropriate reference/subject ratio from the ten verified samples in each arm of one paired round, then apply the estimator across rounds
comparison_contract.proof_timing_boundary: guest execution plus witness generation plus proving plus native verification
comparison_contract.timing_partition: guest execution, witness generation, cryptographic proving excluding witness generation, and native verification are non-overlapping top-level phases whose sum equals verified_request_ns
comparison_contract.independent_verification_timing: outside the proof timing boundary but mandatory for every timed proof
comparison_contract.same_candidate_comparisons: M6 software/precompile, M7 worker scaling, and M9 flat/recursive comparisons use the same paired schedule and ratio rules while binding both arms to one candidate source identity

corpus_authority.generated_workloads: the capture plan materializes every generated workload before candidate execution and binds generator identity, seed, parameters, bytes, and SHA-256
corpus_authority.capture_rule: the capture plan binds every ELF and input by path, bytes, and SHA-256; a path match without a digest match is rejected

sampling_protocol.process_isolation: one fresh child process for every warmup and measured attempt
sampling_protocol.first_order: AB when the low bit of SHA-256(milestone_id + ':' + lane_id + ':' + workload_id) is zero, otherwise BA
host_requirements: stable declared power source and power mode
no thermal-throttling indication during a cohort
no host, OS, toolchain, executable, or backend identity change during a cohort
no unrelated benchmark process admitted by the capture plan

a_a_calibration.arms: the same executable and source identity in both arms
a_a_calibration.sampling: the complete warmup, paired-round, and cooldown protocol above

outcomes.pass: every exact invariant and every required statistical budget passes, the primary target passes, and all evidence validates
hard_fail_conditions: candidate build, execution, proof, native verification, or independent verification failure
semantic output, multiplicity, relation-summary, protocol-preserving geometry, transcript, or proof-byte mismatch
allocation, bounded-worker, scaling, performance, memory, work, proof-size, or verifier budget failure
candidate-only Metal fallback or missing resident-dispatch evidence
a measured attempt deliberately omitted, retried, replaced, or relabelled
raw evidence or artifact digest mismatch
no_verdict_conditions: dirty or unresolvable baseline or candidate source identity before capture
host, power, thermal, toolchain, executable, backend, or security-parameter drift during capture
environmental interruption that is independent of either arm and is retained in the attempt ledger
required authority-host counter or raw artifact unavailable
insufficient complete paired rounds or verified samples
receipt or raw bundle unavailable to the validator
outcomes.promotion_rule: FAIL and NO_VERDICT both prohibit milestone performance promotion

exact: preprocessed, main, interaction, quotient, and total committed cells
constraint degree histogram and maximum log-degree bound
statement, transcript, program, layout, and relation-summary digests
proof bytes and proof size for protocol-preserving changes
hot-loop allocation calls, bytes, frees, and reallocations
submitted, completed, failed, cancelled, and peak-active task counts
statistical: retired_instructions where supported by the authority host
GPU command time on a required Metal lane
observational: stages whose baseline median is below 10 ms or below five percent of verified request time
energy when a calibrated counter is unavailable
queue wait, worker utilization, and steal counts
build time, executable size, and generated-code size

material_stage_rule.below_threshold_outcome: recorded but never used to pass or fail a timing claim

universal_hard_budgets.application: every required workload and lane passes independently; an aggregate or geometric mean cannot hide a failing row
universal_hard_budgets.override_policy: only an explicit narrower milestone gate in this protocol may replace a universal resource budget

optimization_claim_contract.predeclaration: each capture plan names exactly one primary target from the milestone entry before candidate execution
optimization_claim_contract.compatibility_migration: M5 and M8 declare non-inferiority targets and make no speedup claim
optimization_claim_contract.optimization_milestones: M6, M7, and M9 must pass their predeclared improvement target in addition to all non-regression gates

required_disclosures: every component descriptor in protocol order
columns and cells by tree and component
geometry_accounting.comparison_rule: cell ratios use exact integer totals; column counts alone are never accepted as AIR-size evidence

allocation_accounting.prepare_boundary: compile and validate the typed plan, allocate final caller-owned column storage, then reset the counting allocator
allocation_accounting.hot_boundary: execute the prepared row loop into final storage
allocation_accounting.prepare_allocation_call_count: exactly invariant across log_rows 10, 14, and 18 for a fixed family and layout
allocation_accounting.output_bytes: exactly equal to the canonical manifest projection

time_scaling.ratio: larger-log duration divided by adjacent smaller-log duration within the same candidate family
time_scaling.decision: upper 95% confidence bound is no greater than 17.6
time_scaling.meaning: a sixteen-fold row increase may consume at most sixteen-fold time plus ten percent

milestones.name: typed effects and witness pilot

cases.operation: LB with the loaded high bit set
signed DIV with a nonzero divisor

exact_gates: byte-identical witness columns and ordered lookup events
identical component descriptors, cell geometry, relation summaries, statement, transcript, and proof bytes
statistical_gates: universal budgets for every full-proof workload and lane
witness speed lower CI at least 0.97 for every family/log-row case
both adjacent row-count time ratios at most 17.6

corpus.input_rule: software and precompile arms consume byte-identical ordered inputs and publish byte-identical ordered outputs

exact_gates.base_profile_zero_calls: the candidate prover running an unchanged base-profile zero-call ELF has no extension component, descriptor, committed cell, transcript field, or proof-byte change relative to the predecessor
exact_gates.extension_profile_zero_calls: an admitted extension-profile zero-call ELF binds its distinct profile and extension manifest, canonical empty call buffer, two fixed log-four extension descriptors with sixteen all-zero rows each, fixed extension column geometry, and thirteenth relation draw exactly; it is an overhead cohort and is not required or permitted to impersonate base-profile statement or proof identity
exact_gates.semantic_outputs: exact equality for every call count and shape
exact_gates.call_and_relation_multiplicity: exact equality to the admitted call stream

statistical_gates.crossover: the first call count with committed-cell ratio below 1.0 and verified-request speed lower CI above 1.0 is no greater than 512

milestones.name: parallel component proving
milestones.host_admission: the promotion host has at least four physical cores; otherwise M7 is NO_VERDICT

primary_target.comparison: four workers over one worker on the same candidate
primary_target.decision: lower CI is at least max(1.05, 0.70 times the Amdahl ideal)

parallelizable_fraction.definition: sum of one-worker durations of dependency-ready parallel-eligible tasks divided by one-worker verified-request duration
parallelizable_fraction.required_speed_lower_ci: max(1.05, 0.70 / ((1 - p) + p / N)) at N = min(8, physical_cores)

exact_gates: candidate one-worker proof bytes, statement, transcript, relation summaries, and geometry equal the protocol-preserving predecessor
all candidate worker counts produce byte-identical proof and protocol artifacts
peak_active_workers is no greater than configured workers
submitted equals completed plus failed plus cancelled
no task starts or completes more than once
first fatal failure cancels and joins every sibling
nested work does not create another pool or exceed the global bound
task events represent overlap without false hierarchical nesting

statistical_gates.largest_worker_count_speed: required_speed_lower_ci formula above for every qualifying workload

universal_budget_overrides: the 1.15 process-CPU, retired-instruction, and GPU-command-work scaling caps and 1.25 peak-RSS scaling cap replace the corresponding universal caps only when comparing candidate N workers to candidate one worker
the candidate one-worker comparison to its predecessor keeps every universal budget
observational_metrics: two- and four-worker scaling when not the primary target

milestones.name: broad typed-witness migration
exact_gates: all 17 families independently preserve witness bytes, ordered events, descriptors, cells, degree manifests, relation summaries, statement, transcript, proof bytes, and verifier result
all 17 families pass every allocation-accounting gate
handwritten witness writers are not retired until every family and full-proof row passes
statistical_gates: universal budgets for every family case, full-proof workload, and lane
witness speed lower CI at least 0.97 for every family/log-row case
both adjacent row-count time ratios at most 17.6

milestones.name: two-to-one recursive aggregation

comparators: the same leaf proofs independently verified without aggregation

primary_target.comparison: recursive wall time over sequential independently verified flat leaves

exact_gates.leaf_and_parent_summaries: every leaf summary, parent relation summary, transcript binding, and root statement matches the deterministic aggregation manifest and verifies independently
exact_gates.aggregation_tree_shape: exact equality to the balanced canonical tree for every leaf count
exact_gates.worker_bound_and_cleanup: all M7 bounded-worker and failure-cleanup gates

statistical_gates.time_crossover: recursive wall-time lower CI is above 1.0 relative to sequential flat proving no later than eight leaves

universal_budget_overrides: the 1.50 recursive process-CPU, retired-instruction, and GPU-command-work caps replace their universal 1.05 caps only for recursive aggregation against flat leaves
the 0.60 crossover memory target and 1.10 fixed-worker scaling cap replace the universal 1.05 RSS cap only for the named M9 comparisons
observational_metrics: network and serialization time when distribution is enabled

receipt_contract.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON with lexicographically ordered object keys, no insignificant whitespace, and one trailing newline
receipt_contract.content_sha256_definition: SHA-256 of the canonical receipt object with the content_sha256 member omitted
required_raw_properties: all warmup and measured attempts are retained in launch order
failed attempts are retained with exact status and bounded stdout and stderr artifacts
every summary, confidence interval, ratio, and verdict is recomputed from the raw bundle
at least one complete proof artifact per arm, lane, and workload is retained; every other proof retains byte count, digest, and both verifier receipts
the receipt digest binds the protocol, capture plan, raw bundle manifest, and every artifact digest
validator_rejections: missing, non-finite, negative, or wrong-type values
threshold, corpus, schedule, estimator, or identity drift
deleted, reordered, duplicated, retried, replaced, or arm-swapped attempts
source, executable, input, raw-bundle, proof, verifier-receipt, or artifact digest mismatch
Metal fallback or missing required resident-dispatch evidence
a summary or outcome that cannot be reproduced exactly
